description: The heretek-swarm architecture is a decentralized multi-agent system that coordinates autonomous agents (Actors) via a NATS JetStream event mesh and a consensus-based governance protocol (MAKER). Agents use a multi-tiered memory stack (Redis/Postgres/Qdrant) for ephemeral and persistent state, while security guardrails and adversarial detection protect interactions. Observability captures message lineage and LLM execution traces, and a React dashboard enables visual workflow building, deployment, and real-time telemetry. The main flow: users design workflows in the dashboard, trigger deployments and execution commands to the Swarm Core, which coordinates agents, invokes external tools via MCP, persists state to the Memory & State Mesh, enforces security, and emits telemetry consumed by the Observability layer and dashboard.

components.description: The central hub of the monitoring subsystem. It manages the lifecycle of the dashboard, orchestrates periodic data fetching for swarm-wide health and alerts, and provides the execution context and raw telemetry data for child metric components.

components.name: Dashboard Lifecycle Orchestrator
components.description: The central React-based controller that manages state, polling intervals, and data synchronization for the health dashboard; it provides execution context and raw telemetry data to child visualization components.

components.name: Observability & Replay Gateway
components.description: The communication bridge between the frontend dashboard and the backend metrics engine; exposes REST and WebSocket endpoints for health data and manages message replay/time-travel via a Message Replay Manager.

components.name: Health & Anomaly Analytics Engine
components.description: The backend processing core that aggregates raw telemetry from the agent mesh, computes global health scores from consensus and latency, profiles agent behavior, and detects/alerts on anomalies.

components.name: Telemetry & Consciousness Visualization Suite
components.description: A set of specialized UI components consuming orchestrated telemetry to provide agent performance views and advanced visualizations for Integrated Information Theory (IIT) and Free Energy Principle (FEP) metrics.

components.name: Agent Performance Analytics
components.description: A logic-intensive component dedicated to the granular visualization of agent-specific performance. It implements complex client-side operations like multi-field sorting (e.g., by Phi score or status), type-based filtering, and pagination to manage large agent populations within the swarm.

components.name: Grid Orchestration & Data Acquisition
components.description: Central controller and state manager for the analytics grid. Handles React component lifecycle, sets up polling for real-time updates, asynchronously fetches agent metrics, and maintains the primary state for the agent list and user-defined view parameters.

components.name: Performance Data Processing
components.description: Logic-intensive transformation engine that performs client-side operations: multi-field sorting (e.g., by Phi score or status), type/role-based filtering, memoized computations, and pagination to efficiently produce the viewable slice of agents.

components.name: Collective Intelligence & Consciousness Monitor
components.description: The specialized analytics and visualization engine for emergent swarm properties. It calculates cognitive integration (Phi scores) based on Integrated Information Theory (IIT) and utilizes custom SVG-based gauges to visualize agent consciousness states and the Swarm Intelligence Quotient (SIQ).

components.name: Consciousness Runtime & Visualization
components.description: Implements Global Workspace Theory (GWT) and Attention Schema within agents and provides frontend SVG UI components to visualize individual agent awareness and status in real-time.

components.name: Cognitive Analytics & Orchestration

components.name: Collective Intelligence Monitor

components.name: Execution Observability & Trace Engine
components.description: Deep-dive observability tools for auditing swarm execution: visualizing A2A message flows, LLM reasoning traces, and logs to debug interaction patterns and decision-making.

components.name: Real-time Flow & Trace Visualizer
components.description: Manages the live instrumentation and visualization of agent interactions. It captures A2A messages and LLM reasoning traces, broadcasting them via WebSockets to the frontend for real-time flow mapping and reasoning chain inspection.

components.name: Behavioral Audit & Log Analytics
components.description: Provides deep-dive textual analysis and behavioral profiling. It monitors logs for anomalies and compares agent execution patterns against established baselines to detect deviations in the swarm's collective intelligence, surfacing these insights through a centralized logging interface.

components.name: Execution Replay & Forensic Engine
components.description: Facilitates historical debugging and "time travel" by managing the persistence and re-injection of event streams. It allows developers to select specific historical windows and re-run interaction sequences to analyze the root causes of unexpected swarm behaviors.
